player_0.content: New plan: My previous attempt failed because I tracked the positions of all players, which introduced unnecessary complexity and increased the risk of tracking errors, even though I correctly identified that Bob was only involved in the first and last swaps. The mistake was not in the logic of the specific steps I took, but in the inefficiency of the strategy which made the solution fragile. Next time, I will adopt a "target-focused" strategy: I will identify the specific player the question asks about (Bob) and only track the position of that specific player through the sequence of swaps, completely ignoring the movements of other players unless they directly involve the target. I will explicitly verify the target's position after every single swap mentioned in the text, rather than updating a full state table. This minimizes cognitive load and ensures the final answer is derived directly from the target's trajectory.
